title: Present Day Cosmic Acceleration from SDSS and DESI BAO: A Call for Finer Tomography of the DESI Bright Galaxy Survey
efc_relevance: Ferri et al. attribute the DESI+Planck versus SDSS+Planck difference in q0 primarily to redshift coverage (z_eff ≈ 0.295 versus ≈ 0.15), with Pantheon+ restoring a negative q0. This is a caution for interpreting P7's regime-window decomposition and P6's background-level comparisons: survey coverage and extrapolation must be separated from any EFC-specific effect. It does not by itself test either pre-registered prediction.
ledger_action: Add to §4b as external evidence; annotate P7 with the redshift-coverage confound and retain the sealed three-window test unchanged. Do not add to the EFC evidence register or treat the result as support or falsification of P6/P7.
